_comment: Tier-2 for sparta surface_interaction and conjugate_heat_transfer: the per-surf shape rules, the watertight test, and the fact that 'data.circle' names two different bodies inside one SPARTA distribution. Thirteen decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). Verified verbatim: 'Fix ave/surf compute does not calculate a per-surf vector (../fix_ave_surf.cpp:150)' and 'Dump surf compute does not compute per-surf vector (../dump_surf.cpp:569)' for a bare c_ID from 'compute surf', which is always an ARRAY; 'Compute reduce fix does not calculate a per-surf array (../compute_reduce.cpp:293)' for indexing a fix ave/surf fed ONE value, which is a VECTOR — the two shapes are opposite and the deck that gets both right runs; 'Watertight check failed with 2 unmatched points (../surf.cpp:1168)' for an open two-segment curve; '<N> surface points are not inside simulation box (../surf.cpp:1689)'. CORRECTION: both watertight entries said to place the open endpoints on a box face AND read with 'clip'. Executed, clip is not the remedy — the interior open curve fails watertight WITH clip just as without it, and the curve whose endpoints sit exactly on the ylo face is accepted with clip and without. It is the endpoints being on the face that matters. Both entries were fixed in the same commit. The data.circle collision is executed by handing one deck the adapt copy and the ambi copy in turn: each is accepted in the box it was drawn for and rejected in the other, so basename staging can hand a deck a body that does not fit. No count from any run is pinned. COVERS: surface_interaction:4, :7, :8 and conjugate_heat_transfer:3, :6. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 moves the open curve that sat in the INTERIOR so its two endpoints lie exactly on the ylo face - the geometry the accepted case already uses - leaving it open, two-segment and otherwise identical. Both interior decks then load with rc=0 and the 'Watertight check failed with 2 unmatched points (../surf.cpp:1168)' message is gone. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: an_open_curve_in_the_interior_fails_watertight=True, adding_clip_does_NOT_rescue_an_interior_open_curve=True, clip_is_not_what_makes_the_open_curve_legal=True. The per-surf shape cases and the data.circle collision run on decks this control does not touch. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/per_surf_shapes_watertight_and_data_circle_collision && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
